lines.text: The LORD says Israel sells the needy for a linen belt and tramples on the heads of the poor.
The LORD destroyed the Amorite and brought Israel up from Babylon, leading them forty years in the wilderness.
The LORD raised up prophets and Nazirites, but Israel made Nazirites drink wine and forbade the prophets to prophesy.
The LORD will crush Israel: escape fails the swift, the archer will not stand, and the bravest will flee naked.
